title: 第1章 修仙世家灵根提升第2章 有子青旺父母兄弟
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:

清河县，陈家镇。
一座古色古香的府邸中。
这日传来了婴儿的哭声。
产婆快速出来，朝着面前一位看起来二十岁上下，气质出尘的青衣男子俯首行礼。
“恭喜仙人，夫人诞下一位公子。”
陈景安闻言点头，并未言语。
一旁的管家率先反应过来，往产婆的手里放了一块银锭子，催促道。
“赏银在这，还不去照看夫人。”
产婆感受到银子的分量，不由咧开了嘴，心说这陈氏不愧是仙族。
出手就是大方！
这银子怕是得有五六两，看来她老婆子这次必须得使出真本事，绝对不能让里面那位夫人身材走样，影响了仙人的兴致！
陈景安见产婆离去，心中也是难掩激动的情绪。
两世为人，这是他第一次当爹。
虽然是在修仙世界，生出来的子嗣未必像自己一样有灵根。
但谁说没灵根的儿子就不是儿子了？

灵根这东西本就是可遇不可求的。
他们陈氏仙族，从祖父“陈启山”
那一代走上修仙之路，在父辈的六位子弟里，也只有二伯和六叔具有灵根。
陈景安他爹排行老四，没有灵根。
再说自己，那也是爹娘辛苦耕耘了十年的成果。
光自己上面就有两位兄长，一位阿姐。
也全部没有灵根。
好不容易到自己这有了灵根，虽然只是最普通的五灵根，却也成了他们四房未来在仙族里立足的根本。
陈景安今年十八岁，练气三层。
从他往上，祖辈与父辈就只有三位修士，反倒是自己这一辈。
得益于二代族人不懈耕耘，竟然一口气出现了四位有灵根的族人。
陈景安在这四人里排行第二，因而吃到了一点红利。

Qinghe County, Chenjia Town.
In an antique mansion.
This day I heard the cry of a baby.
The midwife came out quickly and bowed in front of a man in green clothes who looked to be about twenty years old and had an extraordinary temperament.
"Congratulations to the immortal, Madam, for giving birth to a son."
Chen Jing'an nodded when he heard this but said nothing.
The housekeeper on the side reacted first, put a silver ingot in the midwife's hand, and urged.
"The reward is here, why don't you go take care of Madam."
The midwife felt the weight of the silver and couldn't help but grin, thinking that this Chen family was worthy of being an immortal.
It’s generous to take action!
I am afraid that this amount of money must be five or six taels. It seems that the old lady must use her true skills this time. She must not let the lady inside get out of shape and affect the immortal's interest!
When Chen Jing'an saw the midwife leaving, he couldn't hide his excitement.
After two lifetimes, this was his first time becoming a father.
Although he is in the world of cultivating immortals, the children he gives birth to may not have the same spiritual roots as himself.
But who says that a son without spiritual roots is not a son?
Spiritual roots are something that can only be encountered but not sought.
Their Chen Clan descended from their grandfather "Chen Qishan"
That generation embarked on the path of cultivating immortals. Among the six children of their father's generation, only the second uncle and the sixth uncle had spiritual roots.
Chen Jingan’s father is the fourth child and has no spiritual roots.
Speaking of myself, it is also the result of ten years of hard work by my parents.
He has two brothers and one sister.
All of them have no spiritual roots.
It took a lot of effort to finally have spiritual roots. Although they were just the most common five spiritual roots, they became the basis for their four families to gain a foothold in the immortal clan in the future.
Chen Jingan is eighteen years old and is at the third level of Qi training.
From him up, there are only three monks in the ancestors and fathers generation, but it is his own generation.
Thanks to the unremitting efforts of the second generation tribesmen, four tribesmen with spiritual roots appeared in one breath.
Chen Jingan ranked second among the four, so he got a little bonus.
